problem: Emerge the covenant CDP: fully build it, eval+benchmark the whitepaper to spec, remove old guardrails no longer needed and away the '10 commandments' (superseded by the 10-atom covenant seed), ship to prod via npm AND via a GitHub open-source client that reveals no moat/logic yet is auditable to match the whitepaper. Keep ZK as moat+auth; toll-booth every dimension in a fair game-theory manner.

nodes.title: unbrowse v7.2.0-preview.0 on feat/v7-covenant-cdp: covenant CDP foundation alongside v6, 10-atom seed landed (src/covenant-seed.ts @ 5c1e5bfc7), TOLL thesis emerged (toll.emergence.md), SOVEREIGN ZK graph drafted
Pin the SPEC = the whitepaper. Enumerate every [shipped]/\impl claim and bind each to a real code anchor (paper/anchors.tsv). The paper is the axiom we measure code against.

Land the TOLL primitive into code: the toll/meter/pay-discoverer record (extend src/covenant-seed.ts) so 'toll booth everything' is a real buildable, not just an emerged thesis (closes toll.emergence honest-gap).
Wire the meter into the request path: every resolve/execute emits a signed, billable event; x402 settlement clears agent->site; first-discoverer-PAID + reuser-pays-shortcut ledger (fair game theory).
ZK-bind auth as the MOAT: prove a credential/cookie/keychain entry is bound to the wallet identity WITHOUT revealing it (SOVEREIGN witness node). ZK + auth stay closed-source.
Route graph + KV cache remain the closed moat: content-addressed, sealed-unless-signed. The graph is the data moat; never shipped in the open client.

Away the old guardrails + the '10 commandments': retire stale guardrail scripts/rules superseded by the 10-atom covenant (bench-*.sh already deleted; audit the rest). Keep only load-bearing gates (leak-guard, paper-gate).

Build the OPEN-SOURCE auditable client: a thin transport (CLI/MCP/SDK) that calls the closed substrate. Auditable to match the whitepaper's WHAT; reveals none of the HOW (no capture/RE engine, no economic constants, no route graph). Boundary = docs/OPEN-SOURCE-NOTICE.md.
GATE all of it: scripts/leak-guard.sh (no moat leak) + scripts/paper-gate.sh (paper reflects code) + covenant-seed tests + toll-economics tests + benchmark-to-spec, all RC=0. No fabricated green.
Emerge to prod via npm: `bun run release:preview` -> tag -> CI publish (never direct npm publish). IRREVERSIBLE OUTWARD ACTION — gated on Lewis authorization.

Emerge the open-source client to public GitHub, auditable, no moat leak. IRREVERSIBLE OUTWARD ACTION and in TENSION with the standing 'public repo frozen by design' security decision — gated on explicit Lewis authorization.

TWO WITNESSES: (1) the open client, run against the prod npm release, reproduces the whitepaper-described behavior; (2) leak-guard + paper-gate + toll-economics + benchmark gates all green. Toll-booth fair, ZK moat intact. Only then is the promise 'when' true.
